+"""Bind actual Jenkins/Fogell SCM revisions to the verified FG-177 pin."""

+

+import os
+import pathlib
+import re
+import sys
+import tempfile

+    "source-branch",
+    "source-revision",
+    "scm-pinned-branch",
+    "scm-pinned-revision",
+    "scm-tree",
+    "jenkinsfile-blob",
+    "jenkinsfile-sha256",
+    "git-pinned-branch",
+    "git-pinned-revision",
+    "git-tree",
+)
+HEX40 = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{40}$")
+HEX64 = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
+
+
+def fail(message: str) -> None:
+    raise ValueError(message)
+
+
+def regular_nonempty(path: pathlib.Path, label: str) -> None:
+    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
+        fail(f"{label} must be a non-empty regular non-symlink file: {path}")
+
+
+def digest(path: pathlib.Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def read_pin(path: pathlib.Path) -> dict[str, str]:
+    regular_nonempty(path, "SCM pin")
+    rows = [line.split("\t") for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
+    if len(rows) != len(PIN_KEYS):
+        fail("SCM pin has the wrong line count")
+    values: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for expected, row in zip(PIN_KEYS, rows, strict=True):
+        if len(row) != 2 or row[0] != expected or not row[1]:
+            fail(f"SCM pin is noncanonical at {expected}")
+        values[row[0]] = row[1]

+        fail("unsupported SCM pin format")
+    if values["source-branch"] != "case/fg177-probe-checkout-scm":
+        fail("SCM pin source branch is not the reserved evidence branch")
+    for key in (
+        "source-revision",
+        "scm-pinned-revision",
+        "scm-tree",
+        "jenkinsfile-blob",
+        "git-pinned-revision",
+        "git-tree",
+    ):
+        if HEX40.fullmatch(values[key]) is None:

+    if HEX64.fullmatch(values["jenkinsfile-sha256"]) is None:

+    observed: dict[str, list[tuple[str, ...]]] = {"Jenkins": [], "Fogell": []}
+    engine = ""
+    if label == "SCM":

+            r"^    \| FG177 EXECUTED SCM REVISION=([0-9a-f]{40}) "
+            r"TREE=([0-9a-f]{40}) JENKINSFILE_BLOB=([0-9a-f]{40})$"
+        )
+        marker = "FG177 EXECUTED SCM"
+    else:
+        pattern = re.compile(
+            r"^    \| FG177 EXECUTED GIT REVISION=([0-9a-f]{40}) "
+            r"TREE=([0-9a-f]{40})$"
+        )
+        marker = "FG177 EXECUTED GIT"
+    for line in receipt.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+        if line == "## Jenkins":
+            engine = "Jenkins"
+        elif line == "## Fogell":
+            engine = "Fogell"
+        elif line.startswith("## "):
+            engine = ""
+        if marker in line:
+            match = pattern.fullmatch(line)
+            if engine not in observed or match is None:
+                fail(f"malformed or out-of-section {marker} line in {receipt}")
+            observed[engine].append(match.groups())
+    result: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {}
+    for name in ("Jenkins", "Fogell"):
+        if len(observed[name]) != 1:
+            fail(f"{receipt} has {len(observed[name])} {name} {marker} lines; expected one")
+        value = observed[name][0]
+        if value != expected:
+            fail(
+                f"{receipt} {name} executed {value}, expected pinned {expected}"
+            )
+        result[name] = value
+    return result
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    if len(sys.argv) != 4:
+        print(f"usage: {sys.argv[0]} PIN RECEIPT_DIR OUTPUT", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    pin_path = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
+    receipt_dir = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
+    output = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[3])
+    if output.exists() or output.is_symlink():
+        fail(f"SCM execution output already exists: {output}")
+    if output.parent.is_symlink() or not output.parent.is_dir():
+        fail(f"SCM execution output parent is not a real directory: {output.parent}")
+
+    pin = read_pin(pin_path)
+    cases = (
+        (
+            "checkout",
+            receipt_dir / "fg177-probe-checkout-scm.receipt.txt",
+            "SCM",
+            (pin["scm-pinned-revision"], pin["scm-tree"], pin["jenkinsfile-blob"]),
+        ),
+        (
+            "unknown-policy-git",
+            receipt_dir / "fg177-probe-unknown-policy.receipt.txt",
+            "GIT",
+            (pin["git-pinned-revision"], pin["git-tree"]),
+        ),
+        (
+            "return-semantics-git",
+            receipt_dir / "fg177-probe-return-semantics.receipt.txt",
+            "GIT",
+            (pin["git-pinned-revision"], pin["git-tree"]),
+        ),
+    )
+    rows = ["format\tfogell-scm-execution-v1\n"]
+    for case_name, receipt, label, expected in cases:
+        observed = executed_by_engine(receipt, label, expected)
+        rows.append(
+            f"case\t{case_name}\t{label.lower()}\t{':'.join(expected)}\t"
+            f"{digest(receipt)}\n"
+        )
+        for engine in ("Jenkins", "Fogell"):
+            rows.append(
+                f"executed\t{case_name}\t{engine.lower()}\t"
+                f"{':'.join(observed[engine])}\n"
+            )
+
+    descriptor, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(
+        prefix=f".{output.name}.", dir=output.parent
+    )
+    temporary_path = pathlib.Path(temporary)
+    try:
+        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+            stream.writelines(rows)
+            stream.flush()
+            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+        temporary_path.replace(output)
+    finally:
+        temporary_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+    print(f"SCM execution matched pinned revisions: {output}")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        raise SystemExit(main())
+    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
+        print(f"ERROR: SCM execution validation refused: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
+        raise SystemExit(1)
